entries.sought: Exact integer algorithms for the proleptic Gregorian calendar: a date to a day count, back, and the weekday

sources.title: chrono-Compatible Low-Level Date Algorithms (Howard Hinnant)
sources.said: days_from_civil: y -= m <= 2; era = (y >= 0 ? y : y-399) / 400; yoe = y - era*400; doy = (153*(m > 2 ? m-3 : m+9) + 2)/5 + d-1; doe = yoe*365 + yoe/4 - yoe/100 + doy; return era*146097 + doe - 719468. civil_from_days is its inverse; weekday_from_days counts from Thursday 1970-01-01.

sources.title: ECMA-262, Time Values and Time Range
sources.said: Time values count milliseconds from 1970-01-01 UTC on the proleptic Gregorian calendar, the calendar the tests read Date against.

entries.sought: How zic turns rules and zone lines into transitions, to compute them the same way
entries.value: outzone (rules taken in UT order, a wall-clock moment read with the save in effect; a line ends at its until read with the save then; the start type from the last rule before it or the first standard-time rule after) and writezone's optimize pass

sources.title: zic.c, tz release 2026e (the tz development repository IANA names at data.iana.org/time-zones/tz-link.html)
sources.said: outzone, lines 3415 to 3725: per zone line, save = 0; for each year, the untried rule with the earliest jtime = r_temp - (r_todisut ? 0 : stdoff) - (r_todisstd ? 0 : save); stop when ktime >= untiltime (until less stdoff and save by its kind); rules before starttime set startoff and the start abbreviation; at the end, starttime = until less save and stdoff. writezone, lines 2691 to 2732: a transition whose local time (at + previous type's offset) is not later than the previous transition's (at + the type before it) replaces it, or removes it when it returns to that type; a transition to the same offset, isdst and abbreviation is dropped.

sources.title: tz NEWS
sources.said: 2026b: zic versions 2023d through 2026a can mishandle a last transition to a new time type in slim output; use zic -b fat. 2026a: zic no longer generates a no-op transition when simultaneous Rule and Zone changes cancel each other out (Asia/Tbilisi, 1997-03-30).

entries.sought: A published method for sunrise and sunset by latitude, longitude and date, with its accuracy
entries.value: NOAA GML solar calculator: Meeus's equations; 0.833° below the horizon; accurate to within a minute between 72°N and 72°S, within ten minutes beyond

sources.title: NOAA GML, Solar Calculation Details
sources.said: The calculations are based on equations from Astronomical Algorithms, by Jean Meeus. The sunrise and sunset results are theoretically accurate to within a minute for locations between +/- 72° latitude, and within 10 minutes outside of those latitudes. For sunrise and sunset calculations, we assume 0.833° of atmospheric refraction. The calculator is no longer actively supported or maintained.

sources.title: NOAA GML solar calculator, main.js
sources.said: calcGeomMeanLongSun, calcGeomMeanAnomalySun, calcEccentricityEarthOrbit, calcSunEqOfCenter, calcSunApparentLong, calcMeanObliquityOfEcliptic, calcObliquityCorrection, calcSunDeclination, calcEquationOfTime, calcHourAngleSunrise (cos 90.833°), calcSunriseSetUTC: timeUTC = 720 - 4*(longitude + hourAngle) - eqTime, refined once at JD + timeUTC/1440.

sources.title: NOAA GML, NOAA_Solar_Calculations_day.xls
sources.said: The worked day as published: 2010-06-21 at latitude 40, longitude -105, time zone -6, every six minutes; columns Julian Day, Julian Century, Geom Mean Long Sun, Geom Mean Anom Sun, Eccent Earth Orbit, Sun Eq of Ctr, Sun App Long, Mean Obliq Ecliptic, Obliq Corr, Sun Declin, Eq of Time, HA Sunrise and onward (xls sha256 1def11406d4548aba852aa303d9c9ac35f0896f55eeaeb6cc9b7bef4a1b90a99; read to values with LibreOffice into research/sources/sun/noaa-solar-calculations-day-2010-06-21.csv). entries.sought: Why the ICU time zones in Node (tz 2025b) differ from the 2026e release for some zones
entries.value: Canada 2026 (BC, Alberta, NWT, Manitoba), Morocco and Western Sahara 2026, Moldova since 2022, Baja California 1953 and 1961-1975, Iran 1979, Colombia 1992

sources.title: tz NEWS, releases 2025c to 2026e
sources.said: 2026e: Manitoba moves to permanent -05 (modelled from 2026-11-01 02:00). 2026d: the Northwest Territories stay on -06; Colombia's 1992-05-02 and Iran's 1979-05-26 spring forwards were at 00:00, not 24:00. 2026c: Alberta moved to permanent -06; Morocco moves to permanent +00 on 2026-09-20, also Western Sahara. 2026b: British Columbia moved to permanent -07 (modelled from 2026-11-01). 2026a: Moldova has used EU transition times since 2022. 2025c: Baja California agreed with California's DST rules in 1953 and in 1961 through 1975.

entries.sought: What VED denotes beside VES, after Venezuela's 2021 redenomination
entries.value: VED/926 represents the redenominated bolívar (1,000,000 times the old VES); VES/928 stays the valid code for the same redenominated bolívar

sources.title: ISO 4217 Amendment Number 170 (1 October 2021)
sources.said: The Bolívar Soberano (VES) is redenominated by removing six zeros from the denominations. A new currency code VED/926 representing the new valuation (1,000,000 times old VES/928) is introduced on 1 October 2021 for any internal needs during the redenomination process, but is not replacing VES as the official currency code. The Central Bank of Venezuela will not adopt the new codes in the local system, VES/928 remains in use. The actual currency code VES/928 remains the valid code after 1 October 2021 to use in any future transactions to indicate the redenominated Bolívar Soberano.

entries.sought: The temperature at which precipitation falls as snow rather than rain

sources.title: Jennings, Winchell, Livneh and Molotch, Spatial variation of the rain-snow temperature threshold across the Northern Hemisphere, Nature Communications 9:1148 (2018)
sources.said: The air temperature at which rain and snow fall in equal frequency varies significantly across the Northern Hemisphere, averaging 1.0 °C and ranging from -0.4 to 2.4 °C for 95% of the stations (6883 stations, 1978-2007).

entries.sought: How a single day departs from its month's normals: the size of the day-to-day swing and how it carries over days, how wet days run cooler by day and warmer by night, the cloud of a dry day, how far a forecast is off, and the curve of temperature through the day
entries.why: The normals give each month's means (the WMO's primary parameters: means of the daily maximum and minimum, the month's precipitation, its wet days, its sunshine), not a day's departure from them; the daily figures behind them aren't part of either set. The game draws each day around the month's normals so that, over the years, the days come back to them (a test holds this), and labels the day-to-day weather its own.

value.spread: 0.3 of the normal daily range, between 1 and 4 °C
value.forecastError: 0.6 °C a day ahead, 0.4 °C more each day
value.curve: low at sunrise, high three hours past solar noon

entries.sought: For the countries and parameters no published normal gives (the WMO's sets, the 1981-2010 normals, the national services', the Deutscher Wetterdienst's and the World Weather Information Service's): the mean daily maximum and minimum temperature, precipitation and days of at least 1 mm, as averages computed from a station's daily observations by the WMO's rules

value.stations: The 25 GHCN-Daily stations of Botswana, the Falkland Islands, Kuwait, Lebanon, Eswatini, Niue, Vanuatu, Suriname, Pitcairn and South Georgia with ten years or more of precipitation or temperature in 1991-2020 (by NCEI's ghcnd-inventory.txt), each placed in the country its identifier names (FIPS 10-4, by ghcnd-countries.txt); stations of other countries near them (Cumberland in South Africa, Changalane in Mozambique, Princess Juliana in Sint Maarten, East End in the U.S. Virgin Islands) left out.
value.rules: WMO-No. 1203 (2017): a day counts where its quality flag is blank; a month's mean is none where 11 or more days are missing or 5 or more in a row (4.4.1 a), a month's sum none where any day is (4.4.1 c), a month's count of days of at least 1 mm a share of the days observed, none by the mean's rule (4.3.1 d, 4.4.1 d); a month's average is the mean of its valid values, a count's mean share times the month's days, February's 28.25 (4.3.2), where they are of at least 80% of the averaging period's years (4.4.2). The averaging period, an average as chapter 3 defines it (over any period), is each parameter's longest within 1991-2020 of ten years or more, from a year with a month of it to another, whose every month is averaged so; the latest of the longest.
value.filled: Suriname's days of at least 1 mm (Johan A. Pengel, 2009-2020) and Pitcairn's maximum and minimum temperature (Pitcairn Island, 1991-2003); the other stations' records are too broken for an average of every month by these rules, or give what their country has from a published normal.

sources.title: NOAA NCEI, Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCN-Daily), version 3: each station's file of daily observations ({id}.csv)
sources.said: A row per day: the station, date, latitude, longitude, elevation and name, then each element's value (PRCP in tenths of mm, TMAX and TMIN in tenths of °C) and its attributes (measurement, quality and source flag); a blank quality flag is a value that passed NCEI's checks.

sources.title: NOAA NCEI, GHCN-Daily: ghcnd-stations.txt, ghcnd-inventory.txt and ghcnd-countries.txt
sources.said: Each station's identifier (its first two letters the FIPS country code), place and name; for each element, its first and last year.

sources.title: WMO Guidelines on the Calculation of Climate Normals, 2017 edition (WMO-No. 1203, ISBN 978-92-63-11203-3), the WMO's PDF as a copy hosts it (29 pages, made 2017-11-30); the WMO e-Library's own page answers with a check this environment can't pass
sources.said: Chapter 3: an average is the mean of monthly values over any specified period. 4.3.1-4.3.2: a count is a share of the days observed, its normal the mean share times the month's days, February's 28.25. 4.4.1: a mean is not calculated where 11 or more days are missing or 5 or more consecutive; a sum only with complete data; a count by the mean's rule. 4.4.2: a normal or average only where there are valid monthly values in at least 80% of the years of the averaging period.

sources.said: Intl.DateTimeFormat with the calendars islamic-umalqura, hebrew, chinese, dangi, persian and ethiopic gives each day's year, month and day; 2026's: 1 Shawwal 1447 = 20 March, 10 Dhu al-Hijjah 1447 = 27 May, 1 Tishri 5787 = 12 September, 15 Nisan 5786 = 2 April, Chinese and Korean New Year = 17 February, 1 Farvardin 1405 = 21 March, 1 Meskerem 2019 = 11 September.

sources.title: Hong Kong Observatory, Gregorian-Lunar Calendar Conversion Tables, 1999 to 2100 (https://www.hko.gov.hk/en/gts/time/calendar/text/files/T{year}e.txt), the Chinese calendar's
sources.said: A row a day: '2027/2/6  1st Lunar Month  Saturday' (Chinese New Year 2027), '2030/2/3  1st Lunar Month  Sunday'; a month whose number repeats is the leap month ('2025/6/25  6th Lunar Month', '2025/7/25  6th Lunar Month'). ICU 77.1's Chinese calendar begins six months a day off these tables in 2000-2100 (2012-08-18, 2018-11-07, 2027-02-07, 2030-02-02, 2057-09-29, 2070-03-13), so the tables are kept, not ICU. The 2069 table leaves out 2069/12/30, between 16 (12/29) and 18 (12/31) of one month: kept as 17.

sources.said: Quels sont les jours fériés légaux ? Le 1er janvier, le lundi de Pâques, le 1er mai (Fête du travail), l’Ascension, le lundi de Pentecôte, le 21 juillet (Fête nationale), le 15 août (l’Assomption), le 1er novembre (la Toussaint), le 11 novembre (l’Armistice), le 25 décembre (Noël). Si ce jour coïncide avec un dimanche ou un jour habituel d’inactivité dans l’entreprise, ce « jour de remplacement » sera nécessairement fixé sur un jour habituel d’activité dans l’entreprise.

sources.said: Vorbemerkungen: 1. In der Schweiz werden die gesetzlichen Feiertage und die Tage, die wie gesetzliche Feiertage behandelt werden, mit Ausnahme des 1. August, durch die Kantone bestimmt. 3. Ohne anderslautende Hinweise gelten die aufgeführten Feiertage für das ganze Gebiet des betreffenden Kantons. 5. Nicht aufgeführt werden jene Feiertage, die auf einen Sonntag fallen. A. Bundesrechtliche Feiertage: Bundesfeiertag, 1. August. B. Kantonalrechtliche Feiertage, a. gesetzlich anerkannte Feiertage and b. Tage, die wie gesetzliche Feiertage behandelt werden, for each canton (Stand: 1. Januar 2011). Uri, Appenzell A. Rh. and I. sources.said: In Ireland there are ten public holidays each year. Public holidays are: New Year’s Day (1st January); First Monday in February; St. Patrick’s Day (17th March); Easter Monday; First Monday in May; First Monday in June; First Monday in August; Last Monday in October; Christmas Day (25th December); St. Stephen’s Day (26th December). Good Friday is not a public holiday and is a normal working day. sources.said: Kirkollisia juhlapäiviä ovat joulupäivä, toinen joulupäivä, uudenvuodenpäivä, loppiainen, pitkäperjantai, pääsiäispäivä, toinen pääsiäispäivä, helatorstai, helluntai, juhannuspäivä ja pyhäinpäivä.

sources.title: Kirkkolaki 1054/1993, 1 luku 3 § (kumottu L:lla 14.4.2023/652)
sources.said: Juhlapäivien aika määräytyy niin kuin läntisessä kristikunnassa vanhastaan on ollut tapana. Kuitenkin juhannuspäivää vietetään kesäkuun 19 päivää seuraavana lauantaina ja pyhäinpäivää lokakuun 30 päivää seuraavana lauantaina.

sources.title: Yliopiston almanakkatoimisto (Helsingin yliopisto), Onko Suomessa arkivapaita enemmän kuin muualla?
sources.said: Suomessa pyhäpäiviä eli kirkollisia juhlapäiviä ovat kirkkolain mukaan joulupäivä, toinen joulupäivä eli tapaninpäivä, uudenvuodenpäivä, loppiainen, pitkäperjantai, pääsiäispäivä, toinen pääsiäispäivä, helatorstai, helluntai, juhannuspäivä ja pyhäinpäivä. Tämän lisäksi juhlapäiviä ovat vappu ja itsenäisyyspäivä. Osa näistä sijoittuu aina viikonloppuun: juhannuspäivä ja pyhäinpäivä lauantaiksi, pääsiäispäivä ja helluntai sunnuntaiksi. ... juhannus- ja jouluaatto ... ovat suurella osalla väestöä palkallisia vapaapäiviä (by collective agreements, not by law: not kept).

sources.title: Holidays Act, R.S.C. 1985 c. H-5 (Justice Laws)
sources.said: 2(1) July 1, not being a Sunday, is a legal holiday and shall be kept and observed as such throughout Canada under the name of "Canada Day". (2) When July 1 is a Sunday, July 2 is a legal holiday and shall be kept and observed as such throughout Canada under the name of "Canada Day". 3 November 11 ... is a legal holiday ... under the name of "Remembrance Day". 4 The first Monday immediately preceding May 25 is a legal holiday ... under the name of "Victoria Day".

sources.title: Canada Labour Code, s. 195, Substitution of general holidays
sources.said: An employer may, in respect of one or more employees subject to a collective agreement, substitute any other day for a general holiday if the substitution is agreed to in writing by the employer and the trade union; ... in respect of employees not subject to a collective agreement, if the substitution has been approved by that employee in writing, or by at least 70% of the affected employees.

sources.title: Government of Alberta, Employment standards – Alberta general holidays
sources.said: General holidays in Alberta: New Year's Day, January 1 (2026: January 1; 2027: January 1); Alberta Family Day, third Monday in February (February 16; February 15); Good Friday, Friday before Easter (April 3; March 26); Victoria Day, Monday before May 25 (May 18; May 24); Canada Day, July 1, except when it falls on a Sunday, then it is July 2 (July 1; July 1); Labour Day (September 7; September 6); Thanksgiving Day, second Monday in October (October 12; October 11); Remembrance Day, November 11 (November 11; November 11); Christmas Day, December 25 (December 25; December 25). Optional general holidays, which employers can choose to recognize: Easter Monday, Heritage Day, National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, Boxing Day.

sources.title: Government of British Columbia, Statutory holidays in B.C.
sources.said: 2026 B.C. statutory holidays: New Year's Day Thursday, January 1; Family Day Monday, February 16; Good Friday Friday, April 3; Victoria Day Monday, May 18; Canada Day Wednesday, July 1; B.C. Day Monday, August 3; Labour Day Monday, September 7; National Day for Truth and Reconciliation Wednesday, September 30; Thanksgiving Day Monday, October 12; Remembrance Day Wednesday, November 11; Christmas Day Friday, December 25.

sources.title: Employment Standards Act [RSBC 1996] c. 113, ss. 1(1), 44-48
sources.said: "statutory holiday" means New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, British Columbia Day, Labour Day, National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day and any other holiday prescribed by regulation. s. 45(2): applies whether or not the statutory holiday falls on the employee's regularly scheduled day off. s. 48(1): an employer may substitute another day off for a statutory holiday if the employer and the employee or a majority of those employees agree.

sources.title: Manitoba Employment Standards, General Holidays (fact sheet)
sources.said: There are nine general holidays throughout the year: New Year's Day; Louis Riel Day (3rd Monday in February); Good Friday; Victoria Day; July 1 (Canada Day); Labour Day; Orange Shirt Day (National Day for Truth and Reconciliation); Thanksgiving Day; Christmas Day. 2026: January 1, February 16, April 3, May 18, July 1, September 7, September 30, October 12, December 25. 2027: January 1, February 15, March 26, May 24, July 1, September 6, September 30, October 11, December 25. Although Remembrance Day is not a general holiday, there are restrictions for operating businesses. What if the general holiday is on a weekend? When a general holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday that an employee does not normally work, the employee must get the next regular workday off with general holiday pay.

sources.title: Government of New Brunswick, Paid public holidays, vacation time and pay
sources.said: Paid public holidays in New Brunswick: New Year's Day; Family Day; Good Friday; Canada Day; New Brunswick Day; Labour Day; Remembrance Day; Christmas Day. If a qualifying employee's paid public holiday falls on a non-working day or during their vacation, the employee who qualifies must receive another working day off with pay in lieu of the holiday, or, if the employee agrees, a regular day's pay.

sources.title: Stewart McKelvey, Client Update: Isn’t Canada Day always on July 1? (June 21, 2018)
sources.said: In New Brunswick and on Prince Edward Island, employment standards legislation does not designate a specific date for Canada Day, so when Canada Day falls on a Sunday, it will be observed on July 2nd, in accordance with the Holidays Act. In Nova Scotia and Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada Day is observed on July 1st, regardless of what day of the week it is.

sources.title: Labour Standards Act, RSNL 1990 c. L-2, ss. 14-16 (House of Assembly of Newfoundland and Labrador)
sources.said: 14(1) In this Part, "public holiday" means New Year's Day, Good Friday, Remembrance Day, Memorial Day, Labour Day, Christmas Day and other days that may be proclaimed by the Lieutenant-Governor in Council as a public holiday for the purpose of this Act. 15(1) An employer shall not require an employee to work under a contract of service on a public holiday. 16 Where a public holiday falls on a day the employee is not required to work, the employer shall not require that employee to work during the 1st working day immediately following the holiday, or on another mutually agreed day.

sources.title: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Treasury Board Secretariat, Paid Holidays - 2026 (September 15, 2025; the provincial public service’s days, which add others to the Act’s)
sources.said: New Year’s Day Thursday, January 1, 2026; St. Patrick’s Day Monday, March 16, 2026; Good Friday Friday, April 3, 2026; St. George’s Day Monday, April 20, 2026; Victoria Day Monday, May 18, 2026; June Holiday Monday, June 22, 2026; Memorial Day Wednesday, July 1, 2026; Orangeman’s Day Monday, July 13, 2026; Labour Day Monday, September 7, 2026; National Day for Truth and Reconciliation Wednesday, September 30, 2026; Thanksgiving Day Monday, October 12, 2026; Armistice Day (Remembrance Day) Wednesday, November 11, 2026; Christmas Day Friday, December 25, 2026; Boxing Day Monday, December 28, 2026.

sources.title: Government of Nova Scotia, Labour Standards, Holidays chart
sources.said: Paid holidays in Nova Scotia: New Year's Day January 1, 2026; Nova Scotia Heritage Day February 16, 2026; Good Friday April 3, 2026; Canada Day July 1, 2026; Labour Day September 7, 2026; Christmas Day December 25, 2026. The Remembrance Day holiday is governed by the Remembrance Day Act. Victoria Day is commonly recognized as a holiday but is not a paid general holiday under the Nova Scotia Labour Standards Code. Boxing Day (December 26, 2026) is a designated retail closing day.

sources.title: Government of Nova Scotia, Labour Standards, Holiday Pay
sources.said: When a paid holiday falls on a regular day off, the employer must give the employee a different day off with pay: the employer can decide that you would get your next scheduled work day off with pay, or an extra day off with pay added to your annual vacation, or you and your employer can agree on any other day off with pay.

sources.title: Government of Ontario, Your guide to the Employment Standards Act: Public holidays (last updated 2024-07-08)
sources.said: Ontario has nine public holidays: New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, Boxing Day (December 26). If a public holiday falls on a day that is not ordinarily a working day for an employee, or during the employee's vacation, the employee is entitled to a substitute holiday off with public holiday pay, or public holiday pay for the public holiday if the employee agrees electronically or in writing. While some employers give their employees a holiday on Easter Sunday, Easter Monday, the first Monday in August, or Remembrance Day, the employer is not required to do so under the ESA.

sources.title: Éducaloi, Les congés fériés (the Loi sur les normes du travail, article 60, and the Loi sur la fête nationale; legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca, cnesst.gouv.qc.ca and canlii.org refuse this environment, 2026-10-27)
sources.said: Jours fériés prévus par la Loi sur les normes du travail : le 1er janvier (jour de l’An); le Vendredi saint ou le lundi de Pâques (au choix de l’employeur); le lundi avant le 25 mai (Journée nationale des patriotes); le 1er juillet ou le 2 si le 1er est un dimanche (fête du Canada); le 1er lundi de septembre (fête du Travail); le 2e lundi d’octobre (Action de grâce); le 25 décembre (fête de Noël). Le 24 juin (fête nationale du Québec) est aussi un jour férié. Le congé est reporté au 25 juin si le 24 tombe un dimanche.

sources.title: Gouvernement du Québec, CNESST, La fête nationale et la fête du Canada restent fériées, même le dimanche! (18 juin 2018)
sources.said: Lorsque la fête nationale est un dimanche : le 24 juin est férié, chômé et payé pour le salarié qui travaille habituellement le dimanche; le 25 juin devient le jour chômé et payé pour le salarié qui ne travaille pas habituellement le dimanche. Lorsque le 1er juillet, fête du Canada, est un dimanche : le jour férié est le 2 juillet pour le salarié québécois.

sources.title: Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts du Québec, Liste des jours fériés et chômés, fermeture des bureaux 2026-2027
sources.said: Vendredi saint – 3 avril 2026; Lundi de Pâques – 6 avril 2026; Journée nationale des patriotes (le lundi qui précède le 25 mai) – 18 mai 2026; Fête nationale du Québec (Saint-Jean-Baptiste) – 24 juin 2026; Fête du Canada – 1er juillet 2026; Fête du Travail (le premier lundi de septembre) – 7 septembre 2026; Action de grâces (le deuxième lundi d’octobre) – 12 octobre 2026; Veille de Noël – 24 décembre 2026; Jour de Noël – 25 décembre 2026; Lendemain de Noël – 26 décembre 2026 : déplacé au 28 décembre 2026; Veille du jour de l’An – 31 décembre 2026; Jour de l’An – 1er janvier 2027; Lendemain du jour de l’An – 2 janvier 2027 : déplacé au 4 janvier 2027.

sources.title: The Saskatchewan Employment Act, SS 2013 c. S-15.1, ss. 2-30 and 2-31 (Publications Saskatchewan, consolidation of 2026-02-12)
sources.said: 2-30(1) "Family Day" means the third Monday in February; "Saskatchewan Day" means the first Monday in August. (2) For the purposes of this Part, the following are public holidays in Saskatchewan: New Year's Day; Family Day; Good Friday; Victoria Day; Canada Day; Saskatchewan Day; Labour Day; Thanksgiving Day; Remembrance Day; Christmas Day. 2-31 An employer may substitute another day for a public holiday, if the union agrees in writing, or if the day meets the prescribed conditions or is approved by the director of employment standards.

sources.title: Government of the Northwest Territories, Education, Culture and Employment, Employment Standards: Frequently asked questions
sources.said: There are 11 statutory holidays in the Employment Standards Act. They are: New Year's Day; Good Friday; Victoria Day; National Indigenous Peoples Day; Canada Day; First Monday in August; Labour Day; National Day of Truth and Reconciliation; Thanksgiving Day; Remembrance Day; and Christmas Day. (Reference: Section 22.) Easter Monday and Boxing Day are not addressed as statutory holidays in the Employment Standards Act. Alternatively, the employer may transfer the holiday to another day, giving the employee a day off with pay.

sources.title: Government of the Northwest Territories, Employment Standards Fact Sheet
sources.said: If the holiday falls on a non-working day and eligible employees do not work, they get an average day’s pay or the employer can provide employees another day off with pay. For example, if a holiday falls on a Sunday, the employer can transfer the holiday to Monday. However, they must clearly communicate what day is being recognized as the statutory holiday in advance.

sources.title: National Indigenous Peoples Day Act, SNWT 2021 c. 15 (office consolidation)
sources.said: June 21 of each year shall be known as "National Indigenous Peoples Day" and shall be observed as a public holiday. Paragraph 22(1)(d) of the Employment Standards Act is repealed and the following is substituted: (d) National Indigenous Peoples Day.

sources.title: Consolidation of Labour Standards Act (Nunavut), R.S.N.W.T. 1988 c. L-1, s. 1 and s. 25(2)
sources.said: "general holiday" means New Year’s Day, Good Friday, Canada Day, the first Monday in August, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day, and the day fixed by the Governor General for observance of the birthday of the reigning sovereign. 25(2) Where a general holiday falls on a non-working day for an employee, an employer shall (a) pay the employee for the general holiday; or (b) give the employee a holiday with pay at some time convenient to the employer and the employee.

sources.title: Ley 51 de 1983 (Normograma de Colpensiones, Administradora Colombiana de Pensiones; funcionpublica.gov.co answered 503 on 2026-10-27)
sources.said: ARTICULO 1o. Todos los trabajadores, tanto del sector público como del sector privado, tienen derecho al descanso remunerado en los siguientes días de fiesta de carácter civil o religioso: primero de enero, diecinueve de marzo, primero de mayo, veintinueve de junio, veinte de julio, siete de agosto, quince de agosto, doce de octubre, primero de noviembre, once de noviembre, ocho de diciembre, y veinticinco de diciembre; además de los días jueves y viernes santos, Ascensión de Señor, Corpus Cristi y Sagrado Corazón de Jesús. 2o. Pero el descanso remunerado del seis de enero, diecinueve de marzo, veintinueve de junio, quince de agosto, doce de octubre, primero de noviembre, once de noviembre, Ascensión del Señor, Corpus Cristi y Sagrado Corazón de Jesús cuando no caigan en día lunes se trasladarán al lunes siguiente a dicho día. Cuando las mencionadas festividades caigan en domingo, el descanso remunerado, igualmente se trasladará al lunes.

sources.title: Ley 2578 de 2026 (junio 01), Normograma del Ministerio de las Culturas, las Artes y los Saberes
sources.said: Artículo 6°. Fiesta Nacional. Declárase el Día de Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Chiquinquirá, que se conmemora el 9 de julio de cada año, como día festivo de carácter nacional, de obligatorio cumplimiento en todo el territorio de la República de Colombia. Por consiguiente, todos los trabajadores, tanto del sector público como del sector privado, tienen derecho al descanso remunerado por la celebración de carácter religioso. Se aplicarán las disposiciones de la ley 51 de 1983 para efectos de determinar el día en el cual se disfrute del descanso remunerado en el calendario. Artículo 7°. Vigencia. La presente ley rige a partir de la fecha de su promulgación. Dada a 1° de junio de 2026.

sources.said: Član 1: Sretenje - Dan državnosti Srbije praznuje se 15. i 16. februara. Član 1a: Nova godina praznuje se 1. i 2. januara, Praznik rada - 1. i 2. maja, Dan pobede 9. maja, a Dan primirja u Prvom svetskom ratu 11. novembra. Član 2: verski praznici: 1) prvi dan Božića (7. januar); 2) Vaskršnji praznici počev od Velikog petka zaključno sa drugim danom Vaskrsa. Član 3: U dane državnih i verskih praznika ... ne rade državni i drugi organi, privredna društva ..., osim na Dan pobede koji se praznuje radno. Član 3a: Ako jedan od datuma kada se praznuju državni praznici Republike Srbije padne u nedelju, ne radi se prvog narednog radnog dana. Član 4: Zaposleni imaju pravo da ne rade u dane sledećih verskih praznika: pravoslavci - na prvi dan krsne slave; katolici ... Božić i Uskršnji praznici prema njihovom kalendaru; pripadnici islamske zajednice - prvi dan Ramazanskog bajrama i prvi dan Kurbanskog bajrama; pripadnici jevrejske zajednice - prvi dan Jom Kipura.

sources.title: Government Gazette of the Republic of Namibia No. 125, 20 December 1990: Public Holidays Act, 1990 (Act 26 of 1990)
sources.said: 1. (1) The days specified in the Schedule shall be public holidays. (2) When a public holiday falls on a Sunday the following Monday shall also be a public holiday, unless that Monday is a public holiday. (3) The President may by proclamation in the Gazette declare any day in a particular year ... to be a public holiday. SCHEDULE: New Year's Day; Good Friday; Easter Monday; Independence Day (the twenty-first day of March); Workers Day (the first day of May); Cassinga Day (the fourth day of May); Ascension Day; Africa Day (the twenty-fifth day of May); Heroes Day (the twenty-sixth day of August); International Human Rights Day (the tenth day of December); Christmas Day (the twenty-fifth day of December); Family Day (the twenty-sixth day of December).

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Namibia in Helsinki, Namibia Public Holidays 2026
sources.said: Public Holidays in Namibia are determined by ... the Public Holiday's Act 1990, (Act 26 of 1990): 1 January Thursday New Year's Day; 21 March Saturday Independence Day; 3 April Friday Good Friday; 6 April Monday Easter Monday; 1 May Friday Workers Day; 4 May Monday Cassinga Day; 14 May Thursday Ascension Day; 25 May Monday Africa Day; 28 May Thursday Genocide Remembrance Day; 26 August Wednesday Heroes' Day; 10 December Thursday International Human Rights Day; 25 December Friday Christmas Day; 26 December Saturday Family Day. According to the Public Holidays Act ... the Monday, following a Sunday which is a public holiday, shall also be a public holiday, unless the Monday is already a public holiday. Observance days, but not public holidays: 9 February Constitution Day; 12 May Nujoma and Tree Planting Day; 16 June Day of the African Child; 28 September Day of the Namibian Child; 24 October United Nations Day.

sources.title: Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth), s. 115 (Compilation No. 73, 7 July 2026; authorised version C2026C00355)
sources.said: 115 (1) The following are public holidays: (a) each of these days: (i) 1 January (New Year’s Day); (ii) 26 January (Australia Day); (iii) Good Friday; (iv) Easter Monday; (v) 25 April (Anzac Day); (vi) the holiday for the birthday of the Sovereign (on the day on which it is celebrated in a State or Territory or a region of a State or Territory); (vii) 25 December (Christmas Day); (viii) 26 December (Boxing Day); (b) any other day, or part-day, declared or prescribed by or under a law of a State or Territory to be observed generally within the State or Territory, or a region of the State or Territory, as a public holiday. (2) If, under a law of a State or Territory, a day or part-day is substituted for a day or part-day that would otherwise be a public holiday because of subsection (1), then the substituted day or part-day is the public holiday.

sources.said: 第二条 全体公民放假的节日：（一）元旦，放假1天（1月1日）；（二）春节，放假4天（农历除夕、正月初一至初三）；（三）清明节，放假1天（农历清明当日）；（四）劳动节，放假2天（5月1日、2日）；（五）端午节，放假1天（农历端午当日）；（六）中秋节，放假1天（农历中秋当日）；（七）国庆节，放假3天（10月1日至3日）。第三条 部分公民放假的节日及纪念日：（一）妇女节（3月8日），妇女放假半天；（二）青年节（5月4日），14周岁以上的青年放假半天；（三）儿童节（6月1日），不满14周岁的少年儿童放假1天；（四）中国人民解放军建军纪念日（8月1日），现役军人放假半天。第四条 少数民族习惯的节日，由各少数民族聚居地区的地方人民政府，按照各该民族习惯，规定放假日期。第六条 全体公民放假的假日，如果适逢周六、周日，应当在工作日补假。部分公民放假的假日，如果适逢周六、周日，则不补假。第七条 全体公民放假的假日，可合理安排统一放假调休，结合落实带薪年休假等制度，实际形成较长假期。

sources.said: ARTICLE PREMIER Conformément à l’article 24.2 du Code du Travail, le jour de la Fête nationale et le 1er mai, Fête du Travail sont jours fériés chômés et payés.

sources.title: Décret n° 2011-371 du 4 novembre 2011 modifiant et complétant l’article 2 du décret n° 96-205 du 7 mars 1996 (loidici.biz’s copy)
sources.said: ARTICLE 2 (NOUVEAU) Sauf dispositions conventionnelles plus favorables, sont fériés et chômés les jours de fêtes civiles ou religieuses dont la liste est établie ci-après : 1°) la fête du 1er janvier ; 2°) le lundi de Pâques ; 3°) le jour de l’Ascension ; 4°) le lundi de la Pentecôte ; 5°) la fête de fin du Ramadan (Ald-El-Fitr) ; 6°) la fête de la Tabaski (Aîd-El-Kébir) ; 7°) le 15 août, fête de l’Assomption ; 8°) le 1er novembre, fête de Toussaint ; 9°) le 15 novembre, Journée nationale de la Paix ; 10°) le 25 décembre, fête de Noël ; 11°) le lendemain de la Nuit du Destin (Lailatou-Kadr) ; 12°) le lendemain de l’anniversaire de la naissance du Prophète Mahomet (Maouloud) ; 13°) le lendemain de la fête nationale ou de la fête du travail chaque fois que lesdites fêtes tombent un dimanche ; 14°) le lendemain de la fête du Ramadan, chaque fois que ladite fête tombe un dimanche ; 15°) le lendemain de la fête de Noël, chaque fois que ladite fête tombe un dimanche ; 16°) le lendemain de la fête de Tabaski, chaque fois que ladite fête tombe un dimanche.

sources.title: States of Guernsey, Public holiday dates (2026 and 2027; the Public Holidays Ordinance, 2009)
sources.said: The statutory public holidays for 2026 are as follows: Thursday 1st January New Year's Day; Friday 3rd April Good Friday; Monday 6th April Easter Monday; Monday 4th May May Day bank holiday; Saturday 9th May Liberation Day; Monday 25th May Spring bank holiday; Monday 31st August Summer bank holiday; Friday 25th December Christmas Day; Monday 28th December Boxing Day (substitute day). 2027: Friday 1st January New Year's Day; Friday 26th March Good Friday; Monday 29th March Easter Monday; Monday 3th May May Day bank holiday; Sunday 9th May Liberation Day; Monday 31st May Spring bank holiday; Monday 30th August Summer bank holiday; Monday 27th December Christmas Day (substitute day); Tuesday 28th December Boxing Day (substitute day). All public holidays are prescribed by the Public Holidays Ordinance, 2009 as follows: New Year's Day, if a weekday; the 2nd January, in a year when New Year's Day falls on a Sunday; the 3rd January, in a year where New Year's Day falls on a Saturday; Easter Monday; the first Monday in May; the 9th May, Liberation Day; the last Monday in May; the last Monday in August; the 26th December, Boxing Day, if a weekday; the 27th December, in a year when Christmas Day or Boxing Day falls on a Sunday; the 28th December, in a year where Christmas Day or Boxing Day falls on a Saturday. "Weekday" does not include a Saturday. Christmas Day and Good Friday (and all Sundays) are customary la[w holidays].

sources.said: Нерабочими праздничными днями в Российской Федерации являются: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 и 8 января - Новогодние каникулы; 7 января - Рождество Христово; 23 февраля - День защитника Отечества; 8 марта - Международный женский день; 1 мая - Праздник Весны и Труда; 9 мая - День Победы; 12 июня - День России; 4 ноября - День народного единства. При совпадении выходного и нерабочего праздничного дней выходной день переносится на следующий после праздничного рабочий день, за исключением выходных дней, совпадающих с нерабочими праздничными днями, указанными в абзацах втором и третьем части первой настоящей статьи. Правительство Российской Федерации переносит два выходных дня из числа выходных дней, совпадающих с нерабочими праздничными днями, указанными в абзацах втором и третьем части первой настоящей статьи, на другие дни в очередном календарном году.

sources.title: Ley 27.399, Establecimiento de feriados y fines de semana largos (B.O. 18/10/2017; argentina.gob.ar, texto)
sources.said: ARTÍCULO 1°.- Establécense como días feriados nacionales y días no laborables en todo el territorio de la Nación los siguientes: FERIADOS NACIONALES INAMOVIBLES: 1° de enero: Año Nuevo. Lunes y Martes de Carnaval. 24 de marzo: Día Nacional de la Memoria por la Verdad y la Justicia. Viernes Santo. 2 de abril: Día del Veterano y de los Caídos en la Guerra de Malvinas. 1° de mayo: Día del Trabajo. 25 de mayo: Día de la Revolución de Mayo. 20 de junio: Paso a la Inmortalidad del General Don Manuel Belgrano. 9 de julio: Día de la Independencia. 8 de diciembre: Día de la Inmaculada Concepción de María. 25 de diciembre: Navidad. FERIADOS NACIONALES TRASLADABLES: 17 de junio: Paso a la Inmortalidad del General Don Martín Miguel de Güemes. 17 de agosto: Paso a la Inmortalidad del General Don José de San Martín. 12 de octubre: Día del Respeto a la Diversidad Cultural. 20 de noviembre: Día de la Soberanía Nacional. DIAS NO LABORABLES: Jueves Santo. … ARTÍCULO 6°.- Los feriados nacionales trasladables establecidos por el artículo 1° de la presente cuyas fechas coincidan con los días martes y miércoles serán trasladados al día lunes anterior. Los que coincidan con los días jueves y viernes serán trasladados al día lunes siguiente. ARTÍCULO 7°.- El Poder Ejecutivo nacional podrá, adicionalmente a lo establecido en el artículo anterior, fijar anualmente hasta tres (3) días feriados o no laborables destinados a promover la actividad turística, que deberán coincidir con los días lunes o viernes.

ARTÍCULO 3°.- Establécese como feriado el día martes 10 de noviembre de 2026, exclusivamente en el ámbito de la Provincia de CÓRDOBA y la CIUDAD AUTÓNOMA DE BUENOS AIRES, con motivo de la visita de Su Santidad el Papa LEÓN XIV. ARTÍCULO 4°.- Establécese como feriado el día miércoles 11 de noviembre de 2026, exclusivamente en el ámbito de la Provincia de BUENOS AIRES, con motivo de la visita de Su Santidad el Papa LEÓN XIV.

sources.title: Ley Nº 7544/2025, que determina los feriados nacionales de la República del Paraguay, se establecen los feriados móviles y se faculta al Poder Ejecutivo a instituir otros feriados en situaciones especiales (Biblioteca y Archivo Central del Congreso Nacional)
sources.said: Artículo 1º.- De los Feriados Nacionales. Determínase como días Feriados Nacionales de la República del Paraguay de cada año, además de los días domingos, los siguientes: • 1 de enero, Año Nuevo. • 1 de marzo, Día de los Héroes de la Patria. • Jueves y Viernes, Semana Santa. • 1 de mayo, Día de los Trabajadores. • 14 y 15 de mayo, Día de la Independencia Nacional. • 12 de junio, Día de la Paz del Chaco. • 20 de junio, Día de la Jura de la Constitución Nacional. • 15 de agosto, Día de la Fundación de Asunción y eventualmente, Día de Transmisión del Mando Presidencial. • 29 de setiembre, Día de la Batalla de Boquerón. • 8 de diciembre, Día de la Virgen de Caacupé. • 25 de diciembre, Día de la Navidad. Artículo 2º.- Feriados Móviles. Establecer como Feriados Móviles, que podrán ser trasladados por el Poder Ejecutivo, los siguientes: • 1 de marzo … • 12 de junio … • 20 de junio … • 29 de setiembre … Artículo 3º.- Traslado de feriados a los días lunes. Autorízase al Poder Ejecutivo a trasladar anualmente, por Decreto, los Feriados Nacionales mencionados en el artículo 2° de la presente ley, a los días lunes, anterior o siguiente al feriado que se traslada. Artículo 4º.- Feriados adicionales. Facúltase al Poder Ejecutivo a fijar cada año, por Decreto, hasta un máximo de tres días adicionales de Feriados Nacionales … Artículo 7º.- Asuetos. … Los asuetos serán considerados días hábiles y no tendrán los efectos de los Feriados Nacionales

Государственные праздники Государственными праздниками в Республике Казахстан являются праздники, отмечаемые в следующие дни: Новый год - 1-2 января; Международный женский день - 8 марта; День Конституции Республики Казахстан – 15 марта; Наурыз мейрамы - 21-23 марта; Праздник единства народа Казахстана - 1 мая; День защитника Отечества - 7 мая; День Победы - 9 мая; День Столицы - 6 июля; День Независимости – 16 декабря. … Статья 5. sources.title: The Holidays (Public General) Act (Laws of Jamaica, page authorized by L.N. 146/1999), Schedule, on the Ministry of Labour and Social Security's site
sources.said: 2. The several days mentioned in the Schedule and such other special day or days as may be appointed under section 7 are hereby declared to be "Public General Holidays". … SCHEDULE 1. New Year’s Day, or in case New Year’s Day falls on Sunday, then the day after New Year’s Day. 2. Ash Wednesday. 3. Easter Monday. 4. The 23rd day of May (or in case the 23rd day of May falls on Saturday or Sunday, then the following Monday) which shall be known as "National Labour Day". 5. The following days in August, that is to say— (a) the 1st day of August (or in case the 1st day of August falls on a Sunday, then the following Monday) which shall be known as "Emancipation Day"; (b) the 6th day of August (or in case the 6th day of August falls on a Sunday, then the following Monday) which shall be known as "Independence Day". 6. The third Monday in the month of October, which shall be known as "National Heroes’ Day". 7. The day after Christmas Day, or when Christmas Day falls on a Sunday, then the 26th and 27th of December. 8. A day appointed by the Minister of national observance.

sources.title: Jamaica Gleaner, Legal Scoop: When a public holiday falls on a Saturday (Shena Stubbs-Gibson, 12 January 2020)
sources.said: The Holidays (Public General) Act (the act) sets out the public holidays that are observed in Jamaica and how to treat them, in the event any falls on a weekend. Since certain holidays, such as Good Friday, Easter Monday, Ash Wednesday and National Heroes Day, occur on the same day each year, it is only New Year’s Day, Labour Day, Independence Day, Emancipation Day, Christmas Day and Boxing Day which are likely to fall on a weekend. … However, since the act makes no similar provision for those instances where these holidays fall on a Saturday, where that occurs, they are to be celebrated on the said Saturday. … However, if Christmas Day falls on a Saturday, Boxing Day will then fall on a Sunday, it will not move to the Monday as Boxing Day is always the day after Christmas Day.

sources.title: ilex.by (ООО «ЮрСпектр»), Переносы рабочих дней и длинные выходные в Беларуси: как отдыхаем в 2026 году (23.07.2025)
sources.said: Согласно постановлению от 22.07.2025 № 397 в 2026 году рабочий день 20 апреля (понедельник) переносится на 25 апреля (суббота). sources.title: Confederația Națională a Sindicatelor din Moldova, Care sunt zilele de sărbătoare nelucrătoare în Republica Moldova? (the Labour Code, art. 111)
sources.said: În Republica Moldova zile de sărbătoare nelucrătoare sunt: a) 1 ianuarie – Anul Nou; b) 7 și 8 ianuarie – Nașterea lui Isus Hristos (Crăciunul pe stil vechi); c) 8 martie – Ziua internațională a femeii; d) prima și a doua zi de Paște conform calendarului bisericesc; e) ziua de luni la o săptămână după Paște (Paștele Blajinilor); f) 1 mai – Ziua internațională a solidarității oamenilor muncii; g) 9 mai – Ziua Victoriei și a comemorării eroilor căzuți pentru independența Patriei; h) 9 mai – Ziua Europei; i) 27 august – Ziua Independenței; j) 31 august – sărbătoarea “Limba noastră”; k) 25 decembrie – Nașterea lui Iisus Hristos (Crăciunul pe stil nou); l) ziua Hramului bisericii din localitatea respectivă, declarată în modul stabilit de consiliul local al municipiului, orașului, comunei, satului.

sources.said: În schimb, unele sărbători importante, precum Ziua Internațională a Femeii (8 martie) și Ziua Europei (9 mai) vor fi marcate în zile de weekend, fără a genera zile libere suplimentare pentru salariați. … Ziua Muncii: 1 mai (vineri); Ziua Copilului: 1 iunie (luni); Sărbătoarea „Limba Noastră”: 31 august (luni); Crăciunul pe stil nou: 25 decembrie (vineri). sources.title: Presidential Order No. 54 of 2017 determining Official Public Holidays (Official Gazette 11 of 13 March 2017; RwandaLII, "the latest version")
sources.said: Article 2 – Scope of application This Order applies to all employees and employers in the public and private sector. Article 3 – Official public holidays Official public holidays in the public and private sector are as follows: 1° 01 January: New Year’s day; 2° 02 January: Day after New Year’s Day; 3° 01 February: National Heroes’ Day; 4° Good Friday; 5° Easter Monday; 6° 07 April: Genocide perpetrated against the Tutsi Memorial Day; 7° 01 May: Labour Day; 8° 01 July: Independence Day; 9° 04 July: Liberation Day; 10° Friday of the first week of August: Umuganura Day; 11° 15 August: Assumption Day; 12° 25 December: Christmas Day; 13° 26 December: Boxing Day; 14° EID EL FITR: the date is announced each year by Rwanda Moslems’ Association; 15° EID AL-ADHA: the date is announced each year by Rwanda Moslems’ Association. Article 4 – Coincidence of official public holidays with weekend days Except 07 April, Genocide perpetrated against the Tutsi Memorial Day, if an official public holiday falls on weekend, the following working day becomes an official public holiday. If two (2) consecutive official public holidays fall on weekend, the two (2) official public holidays are compensated in one (1) working day that follows. In case of coincidence of two (2) official public holidays, the following working day becomes an official public holiday to compensate one (1) of the two (2) coinciding public holidays.

sources.said: Article premier. - La République célèbre le quatre avril comme jour de fête nationale. Art. 2. - Outre la fête nationale et outre les fêtes de Pâques et de Pentecôte tombant un dimanche, les fêtes suivantes sont fêtes légales: Premier janvier ; Premier mai; Journée du Mawloud; Journée de la Korité; Journée de Tabaski ; Lundi de Pâques; Jeudi de l'Ascension; Lundi de la Pentecôte; Journée du 15 août; Journée de la Toussaint; Vingt-cinq décembre. Quand la Korité et la Tabaski tombent un dimanche, le lundi suivant est férié. Art. 3. - Les fêtes légales sont chômées. … la fête religieuse du Mawloud se composant traditionnellement de la nuit du Mawloud proprement dit et de la journée qui suit, il est inutile de préciser au 2° alinéa de l'article que, lorsque le Mawloud tombe un dimanche, le lundi suivant est férié.

sources.title: Burkina24, Burkina Faso : Le pays réduit le nombre de jours chômés et payés de 15 à 11 (9 janvier 2026)
sources.said: Avec cette réforme, le Burkina Faso passe de 15 à 11 jours chômés et payés. Il s’agit notamment du 1er janvier (jour de l’An), du 8 mars (Journée internationale des droits de la femme), du 1er mai (Fête du travail), du 15 mai (Journée des coutumes et des traditions), du 15 août (Assomption), du 11 décembre (Fête nationale), du 25 décembre (Noël), ainsi que des fêtes mobiles que sont l’Ascension, le Mouloud, le Ramadan et la Tabaski. Par ailleurs, certains jours autrefois fériés et payés deviennent désormais des journées de commémoration et de recueillement. Il s’agit du 3 janvier (soulèvement populaire), du 4 août (avènement de la Révolution populaire et démocratique), du 5 août (proclamation de l’indépendance), du 15 octobre (commémoration de l’assassinat du Président Isidore Noël Thomas Sankara), du 31 octobre (Journée nationale des martyrs) et du 1er novembre (Fête de l’armée et Toussaint). Le ministre en charge de la Fonction publique, Mathias Traoré, a indiqué que l’adoption de cette loi abroge immédiatement celle de 2015 qui instituait les fêtes légales et les événements à caractère historique. … Selon Mathias Traoré, désormais, lorsqu’une fête tombe un dimanche, le lendemain ne sera plus automatiquement déclaré chômé.

sources.title: WageIndicator Mali, Congé annuel et vacances (mis à jour le 2026-03-30)
sources.said: Les jours fériés au Mali sont régis par la loi du travail 05-040 du 22 juillet 2005. Cette loi combine toutes les autres lois sous le code du travail et établit ces 12 jours fériés officiels. Cette dernière donne également au gouvernement le pouvoir d'établir des fêtes nationales ponctuelles tout au long de l'année si l'occasion se présente. … 1er janvier - Jour de l’année ; 20 janvier - Journée des forces armées ; 26 mars - Jour des martyrs/Jour de la démocratie; 22 avril - lundi de Pâques ; 1er mai - Fête du travail ; 25 mai - Journée de l'Afrique ; 5 juin – Korité/Fin du Ramadhan ; 12 août – Tabaski/Fête du Sacrifice ; 22 septembre - Jour de l'indépendance ; 10 novembre - Anniversaire du prophète Mahomet ; 17 novembre - Baptême du prophète et 25 décembre - le jour de Noël. Les jours fériés qui tombent un dimanche sont déplacés au lendemain c’est-à -dire le lundi suivant. Les vacances qui se produisent un samedi restent à cette date. … Source: Articles 1-3 de la Loi N° 05-040 du 22 juillet 2005 relative aux fêtes légales en République du Mali.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Cabinet declares January 1 public holiday (17 December 2025)
sources.said: The Cabinet approved the suspension of work in all ministries, government agencies, public bodies and institutions on Thursday, January 1, 2026, on the occasion of the New Year holiday.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Civil Service Commission Declares January 18 a Public Holiday for Isra and Miraj (5 January 2026)
sources.said: Sunday, January 18, 2026, will be an official public holiday, with official working hours resuming on Monday, January 19, 2026.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Cabinet declares Feb 25–26 National Holidays (10 February 2026)
sources.said: The Cabinet decided to suspend work in all ministries, government agencies, public bodies, and institutions on Wednesday and Thursday, February 25 and 26, marking National Day and Liberation Day.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Kuwait Sets Eid Al-Fitr Holiday Starting Thursday, March 19 (10 March 2026)
sources.said: if Ramadan lasts 29 days, the holiday will instead run from Thursday, March 19, through Sunday, March 22, and work will resume on Monday, March 23.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Crowds of Muslim worshippers perform Eid Al-Fitr prayers in Kuwait (20 March 2026)
sources.said: large numbers of Muslim worshippers performed Eid Al-Fitr prayers on Friday morning

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Kuwait announces Eid Al-Adha public sector holiday from May 26 to 31 (19 May 2026)
sources.said: Kuwait’s Cabinet on Tuesday announced the Eid Al-Adha holiday in the public sector, which will run from May 26 to 31, 2026 … on the occasion of the Day of Arafat and Eid Al-Adha for the year 1447 AH.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Kuwait Celebrates Eid Al-Adha with Traditional Sacrifice Rituals (27 May 2026)
sources.said: Kuwaiti philanthropists and residents began performing animal sacrifice on Wednesday – the first day of Eid Al-Adha (Day of Sacrifice) holiday.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Hijri New Year Begins Tomorrow; Public Holiday on Tuesday (15 June 2026)
sources.said: The beginning of the Hijri year 1448 was confirmed on Monday evening following the sighting of the crescent moon marking the start of the month of Muharram. Accordingly, Tuesday will be observed as the official public holiday for the Islamic New Year.

sources.title: Times Kuwait, Kuwait declares August 27 public holiday for Prophet’s Birthday (11 August 2026)
sources.said: Government employees in Kuwait will get a day off on Thursday, August 27, as the Council of Ministers has approved a public holiday marking the Prophet Muhammad’s Birthday (Mawlid Al-Nabawi).

sources.title: Lexivox, Decreto Supremo Nº 2750 de 1 de mayo de 2016 (texto de la Gaceta Oficial)
sources.said: Artículo 2°.- (Feriados nacionales) Los feriados nacionales con suspensión de actividades públicas y privadas en el Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia, son los siguientes: 1° de enero (Año Nuevo); 22 de enero (Día de la Creación del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia); Lunes y martes de Carnaval; Viernes Santo; 1° de mayo (Día del Trabajo); Corpus Christi; 21 de junio (Año Nuevo Aymara Amazónico); 6 de agosto (Día de la Independencia de Bolivia); 2 de noviembre (Día de Todos los Difuntos); y 25 de diciembre (Navidad).

sources.title: Lexivox, Decreto Supremo Nº 5019 de 13 de septiembre de 2023 (texto de la Gaceta Oficial)
sources.said: “ARTÍCULO 3.- (TRASLADO DE FERIADOS NACIONALES Y FERIADOS POR EFEMÉRIDES DEPARTAMENTALES). Se considera feriado con suspensión de actividades públicas y privadas, los días lunes posteriores a los feriados nacionales y feriados por efemérides departamentales que correspondan a día domingo, con excepción de los feriados señalados en los incisos c), d), f), i) del Artículo precedente.” … “g) 21 de junio (Año Nuevo Andino Amazónico Chaqueño); ”

sources.title: Lexivox, Decreto Supremo Nº 1210 de 27 de abril de 2012 (texto de la Gaceta Oficial)
sources.said: Adicionalmente al feriado del 1 de Mayo, por el “Día del Trabajo”, a partir de la presente gestión se declara feriado con suspensión de actividades públicas y privadas en todo el territorio del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia: El día lunes inmediato anterior al 1 de mayo, en caso de que esta fecha sea en día martes. El día viernes inmediato posterior al 1 de mayo, en caso de que esta fecha sea en día jueves.

sources.title: Ministerio de Minería y Metalurgia, Decreto Supremo N° 5521 de 13 de enero de 2026 (texto de consulta de la Gaceta Oficial)
sources.said: ARTÍCULO 3.- … a. Adicional al feriado de Corpus Christi del jueves 4 de junio, se declara feriado nacional el viernes 5 de junio; b. Adicional al feriado del Día de la Independencia de Bolivia del jueves 6 de agosto, se declara feriado nacional el día viernes 7 de agosto. ARTÍCULO 4.- … a. Se traslada el feriado nacional del jueves 22 de enero, Día de la Creación del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia, al viernes 23 de enero; b. sources.title: Arbeidswet 2000 BES (BWBR0028202), artikel 23, tekst geldend vanaf 1 januari 2025 uit de officiële repository (wetten.overheid.nl weigert deze omgeving)
sources.said: Artikel 23 1 Voor de toepassing van deze wet en de daarop berustende bepalingen wordt verstaan onder feestdag: a. Nieuwjaarsdag; b. de datum vallende na de datum van de in het openbaar lichaam Saba gehouden Carnavalsoptocht; c. de Goede Vrijdag; d. de Eerste en Tweede Paasdag; e. de Hemelvaartsdag; f. de Pinksterzondag; g. de Eerste en Tweede Kerstdag; h. de dag waarop de verjaardag van de Koning officieel wordt gevierd; i. de Dag van de Arbeid; j. voor het openbaar lichaam Bonaire de dag waarop de viering van Dia di Rincon plaatsvindt; k. voor het openbaar lichaam Sint Eustatius de datum 1 juli; l. de datum 6 september voor het openbaar lichaam Bonaire, de datum 16 november voor het openbaar lichaam Sint Eustatius en de datum van de eerste vrijdag van december voor het openbaar lichaam Saba. 2 De Dag van de Arbeid wordt jaarlijks gevierd op 1 mei, tenzij die dag op een zondag valt of op die dag de verjaardag van de Koning officieel wordt gevierd, in welke gevallen de Dag van de Arbeid op de eerst volgende werkdag wordt gevierd. 3 Het bestuurscollege van een openbaar lichaam is bevoegd te bepalen dat in het openbaar lichaam de in het eerste lid, onderdeel b of l bedoelde feestdag op een andere datum wordt gevierd.

sources.title: Gobiernu di Kòrsou, Digitaal loket, Officiële vrije dagen op Curaçao (Nationale Feestdagen)
sources.said: Op Curaçao zijn de officiële vrije dagen bij wet vastgesteld. Werknemers* hebben op deze dagen een vrije dag … De officiële feestdagen zijn in de Arbeidsregeling Curaçao vastgelegd. … Nieuwjaarsdag 1 dag 1 januari; De maandag na de Grote Karnaval 1 dag datum varieert; Goede Vrijdag; Pasen (1e en 2e Paasdag) 2 dagen; Hemelvaart; Pinksterenzondag; Kerstmis (1e en 2e Kerstdag) 25 en 26 december; Koningsdag 27 April; Dag van de arbeid 01 mei *; Koninkrijksdag 15 december; Dag van het volkslied en vlag 2 juli; Land Curaçao (dia di pais Korsou) 10 oktober; Ouderjaarsavond aantal uren 31 december. * Als de Dag van de Arbeid op een zondag valt of op de dag dat de verjaardag van de Koning officieel wordt gevierd, dan wordt de Dag van de Arbeid op de eerst volgende werkdag gevierd. … De officiële vrije dagen [2023]: Nieuwjaarsdag zondag 1 januari; Karnaval maandag 20 februari; Goede Vrijdag vrijdag 7 april; Pasen zondag en maandag 9 en 10 april; Koningsdag donderdag 27 april; Dag van de Arbeid maandag 1 mei; Hemelvaartsdag donderdag 18 mei; Dia di Himno i Bandera zondag 2 juli; Dia di Pais Kòrsou dinsdag 10 oktober; Kerstmis maandag en dinsdag 25 en 26 december; Ouderjaarsavond zondag 31 december. sources.said: In accordance with 1 V.I. Hamilton Jackson Day; November 11 Veterans Day; Fourth Thursday in November Thanksgiving Day; December 25 Christmas Day; December 26 Christmas Second Day.

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Bryan Joins Virgin Islands Community in Recognizing Juneteenth; Government Offices to Close Friday (17 June 2026)
sources.said: In observance of Juneteenth, all Government of the Virgin Islands offices will be closed on Friday, June 19.

sources.title: Government of the U.S. Virgin Islands, Governor Bryan Grants Administrative Leave to Non-Essential Government Employees on Nov. 2 and Nov. 27 (19 October 2026)
sources.said: non-essential government employees will receive administrative leave on Monday, Nov. 2, for Liberty Day, and Friday, Nov. 27, the day after Thanksgiving. Non-essential government offices will be closed on both days. … Liberty Day, also known as D. Hamilton Jackson Day, is celebrated each year on Nov. 1. … Because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday this year, the Governor has granted administrative leave to non-essential employees on Monday, Nov. 2.
